description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mahasenpura, Thissamaharama D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830077 (23/0532)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
